title: Long Exposure
description: A camera pointed at an Abbey Road sleeve and its record standing in a dark room. Hold to open the shutter and drag to paint glowstick trails that burn into the exposure while the cover slowly emerges from the dark; let go and the developed photo drops into a stack of prints.
intent: One photographic process finished to the edge: a real bulb exposure where light adds up, cores burn white and bloom, a record sleeve surfaces out of the black the longer you hold, and the sensor grows noisy.
